@G = external global <2 x i64>

define i32 @addshl_5_8(i32 %a, i32 %b) {
  %A = alloca <2 x i64>, align 16
  store <2 x i64> poison, ptr %A, align 16
  %LGV = load <2 x i64>, ptr @G, align 16
  %c = shl i32 %a, 5
  %d = shl i32 %b, 8
  %B = sub <2 x i64> %LGV, splat (i64 -9223372036854775808)
  %e = add i32 %c, %d
  store <2 x i64> %B, ptr %A, align 16
  ret i32 %e
}

define <4 x i8> @test_sle_b(<4 x i8> %a, <4 x i8> %b) {

  store i1 poison, ptr %A, align 1
  %LGV1 = load half, ptr @G.2, align 2
  %C = fcmp ule half +qnan, %LGV1
  %cmp = icmp sle <4 x i8> %a, %b

  store i1 %C, ptr %A, align 1
  ret <4 x i8> %res
}

define <4 x i16> @wide_zext_v4i16(<4 x i16> %a, <4 x i16> %b) {
  %x = zext <4 x i16> %a to <4 x i32>
  %y = zext <4 x i16> %b to <4 x i32>
  %d = sub <4 x i32> %x, %y
  %s = lshr <4 x i32> %d, splat (i32 1)
  %r = trunc <4 x i32> %s to <4 x i16>
  ret <4 x i16> %r
}

}

  ret <2 x i32> %res
}

; Function Attrs: nounwind
define void @shl_32bytes_dwordOff(ptr %src.ptr, ptr %dwordOff.ptr, ptr %dst) #0 {
  %A = alloca i8, align 1
  store i8 poison, ptr %A, align 1
  %src = load i256, ptr %src.ptr, align 1
  %dwordOff = load i256, ptr %dwordOff.ptr, align 1
  %B = shl i8 16, 0
  %bitOff = shl i256 %dwordOff, 6
  %res = shl i256 %src, %bitOff
  store i256 %res, ptr %dst, align 1
  store i8 %B, ptr %A, align 1
  ret void
}
